title: Adopted strict-localization base change on the closed geometric stalk
statement: Let f:X→S be quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism], Ω an algebraically closed field, and s:Spec Ω→S a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point]. Let A be henselian local with separably closed residue field [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology] and e:Spec A≅strictLocalization(s), the adopted full pointed-affine-neighbourhood model. Suppose p₀:X₀→X and f₀:X₀→Spec A form a cartesian square [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square] over f and e.hom followed by strictLocalizationToBase(s). For every separably closed field k, morphism a:Spec k→Spec κA, abelian étale sheaf G on X [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and q∈ℕ, H^q of the derived base-change mate [def-weil-pbc-derived-exchange] at G[0] is invertible on the geometric stalk [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] at a followed by the residue closed-point map. This is the exact fully proved adopted declaration; the original small-colimit statement remains the separate node lem-weil-pbc-strict-local-base-change-closed-stalk.

proof.text: Apply the adopted model-global-homology theorem to K=G[0] and n=q. For the resulting homology sheaf map, enlarge k to its algebraic closure. The extended geometric point lies over the closed point since Spec of the residue quotient maps every point to the maximal ideal. The strictly henselian sections/stalk theorem makes the global germ of each homology sheaf invertible, and its naturality identifies the section map followed by the target germ with the source germ followed by the stalk map. The section map is invertible by the model theorem and the natural sections comparison, so cancelling the invertible source germ proves that the extended stalk map is invertible. Naturality of the invertible geometric-field-extension comparison then gives invertibility at the original point. This node records an existing fully proved library theorem and adds no Lean declaration or unproved step.

theorem isIso_strictHenselization_baseChange_closedStalk
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S)
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [HenselianLocalRing A]
    [IsSepClosed (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)]
    (eA : Spec (.of A) ≅ strictLocalization s)
    {X₀ : Scheme.{u}} (p₀ : X₀ ⟶ X) (f₀ : X₀ ⟶ Spec (.of A))
    (sq₀ : IsPullback p₀ f₀ f (eA.hom ≫ strictLocalizationToBase s))
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsSepClosed k]
    (a : Spec (.of k) ⟶ Spec (.of (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)))
    (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (q : ℕ) :
    IsIso ((pointSmallEtale
      (a ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (IsLocalRing.residue A)))).sheafFiber.map
        ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ (q : ℤ)).map
          ((derivedBaseChangeMapPlus AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} sq₀.toCommSq).app
            ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj G))))
